sources.title: clap-htsat-unfused: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview clap-htsat-unfused is a contrastive language-audio pretraining model developed by laion that learns joint embeddings of audio and text by aligning them in a shared latent space. The model combines an HT-SAT (Hierarchical Token-Semantic Audio Transformer) audio encoder with a text encoder to enable zero-shot audio classification, text-to-audio retrieval, and feature extraction tasks ...
